title: Recipe database entry
description: One recipe from recipe_database.json. protein_g/fibre_g/calories are calculated from standard USDA-equivalent ingredient data per the file's own top-level 'note' field — not lab-verified, spot-check recommended. Never generated or estimated by any model/LLM in this repo; src/recipe_db.py validates and flags, never edits, these values.

name.description: Recipe name. Used as the natural unique key (no separate recipe_id field) — must be unique after case/whitespace normalization.

diet_type.description: Observed vocabulary: vegetarian (the whole database is vegetarian per its description).

protein_g.description: Grams of protein per serving. Calculated (see file-level note), not lab-verified.

fibre_g.description: Grams of fibre per serving. Calculated (see file-level note), not lab-verified.

prep_time_min.description: Minutes to prepare, compared against meal_prep_time_min from Layer 1/Layer 2.

vitamin_tags.description: Observed vocabulary: Iron, B12, Vitamin C, Vitamin D, Multivitamin — matches the vitamin_focus vocabulary in src/data_pipeline.py so Layer 1 output and this database can be joined on it.

pairs_with_roti.description: Whether this recipe is eaten with roti at all. In the current data this is True for every Indian recipe and False for every European/Mexican one — flagged by src/recipe_db.py as worth a second look, not treated as an error.

suitable_meal.description: Observed vocabulary: lunch, dinner, both. (breakfast/snack not observed but not excluded going forward.)
